name: Discovery Pattern Threshold Rules
description: Configuration for when Discovery may treat observations as a pattern.
singleObservationRules: A single observation may become an open question.
A single observation may become a provisional reflection if useful and correctable.
A single observation must not automatically become a pattern.
A single observation must not become an identity claim.
patternQualityGuidance: Patterns should be evidence-linked, context-aware, and participant-correctable.
Patterns should preserve exceptions and contradictions.
Patterns should not classify the participant.
Patterns should not collapse tensions into a single explanation.
participantAuthorityGuidance: Participant confirmation can establish or strengthen a pattern.
Participant correction can weaken, reframe, or retire a pattern.
Participant disagreement supersedes Discovery interpretation in identity-adjacent areas.
